result.no_target: Could not talk to the target

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (s)
refresh_interval.description: How often openocd is asked for the MCU state. Each poll briefly attaches to the probe.

target_name.label: Target name
target_name.description: openocd target used for curstate, e.g. stm32u5x.cpu

camera_desktop.label: Camera desktop entry
camera_desktop.description: Desktop file id launched by the Camera button, e.g. usbcam

camera_match.label: Camera process match
camera_match.description: pgrep -f pattern that identifies the running camera app.

serial_desktop.label: Serial log desktop entry
serial_desktop.description: Desktop file id launched by the Serial log button, e.g. serial-log

serial_match.label: Serial log process name
serial_match.description: Exact process name (pgrep -x) that identifies the running serial logger.

openocd_bin.label: openocd binary
openocd_bin.description: Path or name of the openocd executable.

show_label.label: Show state text
show_label.description: Show Running/Halted next to the icon in the bar.
